look.why: A warm bamboo-sunlight yellow that echoes its forest habitat while contrasting with the dark olive-black scales.

size.measure: total length 3–4 m, up to 5.5 m (longest venomous snake)

habitat.text: Dense tropical forests, bamboo thickets, and mangrove swamps across South and Southeast Asia.

diet.text: Primarily other snakes—including pythons and rat snakes—plus occasional monitor lizards.

facts.text: The world's longest venomous snake, capable of rearing a third of its body upright to look an adult human in the eye.
The only known snake species that builds an above-ground nest mound of dead leaves to guard its eggs.

facts: Ular berbisa terpanjang di dunia, sanggup menegakkan sepertiga tubuhnya hingga sejajar mata manusia dewasa.
Satu-satunya spesies ular yang diketahui membangun gundukan sarang dari daun kering untuk menjaga telurnya.
